hypotheses.H1: IV-X, ISMN 20-30 cm z: forward-chained OLS [ERA5 RZ + X] vs [ERA5 RZ]; paired dR (30-d blocks, 2000, seed 42); one-sided p=P*(dR<=0); Holm over 6; dR>=0.02; dR>placebo q95 (500 year permutations)
hypotheses.H2: IV-X: partial r(ISMN z, X | ERA5 RZ z, ERA5 0-28 z) one-sided p; Holm; r>=0.10 (rules out depth artefact of F4 B V10)
hypotheses.H3: IV-X: lead (Granger): forward-chained OLS of y(t+14)-y(t) on [y(t), ERA5 RZ, ERA5 0-28] +/- X; paired dR; Holm; dR>=0.02; dR>placebo q95
hypotheses.H4: supportive, descriptive (n~6 onsets): freq-matched thresholds; X earlier than ERA5 0-100 AND 0-28 in >=5/6 onsets; median advantage vs 0-28 >=7 d and > placebo q95 (200 year permutations); false-onset frac <= 0-28 + 0.15
hypotheses.no_harm: all-year, XI-III, 5 cm: dR upper CI >= 0 and dR >= -0.02

decisions.PSMA: H1 and H2 and no_harm -> index enters p_soil_drought (combined predictor, rho = forward-chained out-of-sample R)
decisions.lead_text: H3 and H4 -> dashboard early-warning sentence
decisions.depth_artefact: H1 and not H2 -> rejected, recorded as depth artefact (F4 B V10 pattern)
decisions.tie: both accepted -> EDDI14 unless SESR14 model beats EDDI14 model with paired dR lower CI > 0
decisions.cdi: CDI classes unchanged in every outcome (D-042)
